prompt:
Single full-bleed vertical3:5 game upgrade-card painting, final720x1200 RGB. References are this project's original card paintings: match their coarse thick digital oil/impasto brushwork, desaturated dark charcoal/deep brown palette, northern knotwork materials, upper-left key light and heroic slightly low-angle half-length portrait. NOT pixel art, NOT photography, no glossy3D. Face and ALL identifying objects in upper55%; top of head near y8-12%, face around y18-30%, hands above y48%; bottom40% very dark plain drapery/haze with minimal detail, reserved for text overlay. Keep important objects inside x7%-93% and y5%-53%, not cropped. Real anatomically connected hands, coherent weapons and natural face. No text, typography, readable words, border, signature, logo, watermark. Small abstract magical geometric marks allowed, never lines of readable writing. One finished image.
NEW SUBJECT matching style only: robust handsome mature golden blond male, short neatly rugged beard, a real woven WHEAT-EAR crown rather than metal crown. Green wool robe and old gold trim under brown leather armor, modest northern knotwork, warm sunlight from upper left. Tender leaf-green #99E666 and wheat-gold accents. One FREE-FLOATING LONGSWORD levitates vertically beside shoulder x23%, leaf-shaped steel blade pale green-gold glow, entire continuous blade, crossguard, grip, pommel visible between y8%-49%, not held in hand. Natural hands folded loosely high at chest, or concealed by sleeve, do not add grasping swords. A living golden-bristled WILD BOAR companion nestled beside his lower chest, head/snouted profile with two short tusks and bristle mane readable at x60-85%, y38-50%; standing on a rock whose top is cropped at portrait waist, so boar is clearly beside his feet in implied terrain yet its head stays above text mask. Do not add an emblem instead of boar. Boar head smaller than human torso, anatomically coherent. Background muted golden wheat and dark cloud hints upper half, otherwise same dark painting. Full head, crown, sword tip safely inset, no writing, no bright foreground in lower40%.
